short.zh: 理解体系结构，优化计算与数据访问。
short.en: Optimize computation and data access for the architecture.

description.zh: 围绕多核与众核平台上的程序性能开展研究。Crystal-MD 在神威·太湖之光上的工作关注访存模式；Crystal-KMC 在天河二号上的工作结合 MPI、OpenMP 与 MIC 协同执行。
description.en: Research on program performance across multicore and manycore platforms. Crystal-MD work on Sunway TaihuLight studies memory access, while Crystal-KMC work on Tianhe-2 combines MPI, OpenMP and MIC execution.

short.zh: 面向可扩展程序设计与并行执行。
short.en: Programming models and optimization for scalable execution.

description.zh: 导师公开项目涉及高生产率并行模型与编译验证、多范例并行构件及面向 E 级系统的并行编译优化，体现从编程模型到系统执行的研究联系。
description.en: Public project records cover high-productivity parallel models and compilation verification, multi-paradigm parallel components, and compilation optimization for exascale systems.

title.zh: 分布式系统与云数据管理

short.zh: 研究数据存储、访问与事务处理。
short.en: Study data placement, access and transaction processing.

description.zh: 代表性工作包括面向热临时数据的校验式分布式存储、基于 Berkeley DB 扩展的 POST 事务处理中间件，以及兼顾访问频率与相似度的云存储数据划分。
description.en: Selected work includes checksum-based storage for hot temporary data, the POST transaction middleware extending Berkeley DB, and cloud data partitioning that considers access frequency and similarity.

short.zh: 连接并行算法与材料、工程模拟。
short.en: Connect parallel algorithms with materials and engineering simulation.

description.zh: 以材料微观演化模拟和粒子类问题为研究场景，相关成果涉及分子动力学、动力学蒙特卡洛与大气动力学求解器移植优化，关注科学计算软件在超算平台上的实现。
description.en: Materials evolution and particle problems motivate work on molecular dynamics, kinetic Monte Carlo and porting atmospheric dynamics solvers to supercomputing systems.
